(()=>{let results=[];const select=document.querySelector('#mode');for(const o of select.options){select.value=o.value;select.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));for(const input of document.querySelectorAll('#controls input')){for(const endpoint of [input.min,input.max]){input.value=endpoint;input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));const s=optimizationState();if(!s.point.every(Number.isFinite)||!s.display.every(Number.isFinite)||s.fields.some(a=>/NaN|Infinity/.test(a[1])))throw Error('nonfinite '+o.value);}}results.push({mode:o.value,state:optimizationState().point,parts:document.querySelectorAll('[data-part]').length});}return results})()
